ns2:course.label: Ethnomusicology Perf Ensembles
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 271) Instruction and experience in the performance of various non-Western and vernacular music traditions such as , African mbira, Andean panpipes, North American string band , European traditional music, etc. Topics vary according to available instructors. Maximum of 2 hours in the same term. Maximum of 8 hours in subsequent terms. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor required.
